questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

8 × 4 - 7 + 8 ÷ 2 = 35
questions.solution:
Given equation : 8 × 4 - 7 + 8 ÷ 2 = 35

By using **BODMAS RULE** :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69fe6677a411a04dbb8fb93954e08a133938c9ee931d65e12d084aa540736ba3.png] 

Option 1) : ÷ and -

Given equation : 8 × 4 - 7 + 8 ÷ 2 = 35

After interchanging symbols in the given equation is : 

⇒ 8 × 4 ÷ 7 + 8 - 2 = 35

⇒ 8 × 0.5714 + 8 - 2 = 35

⇒ 4.5712 + 8 - 2 = 35

⇒ 12.5712 - 2 = 35

⇒ 12.5712 - 2 = 35

⇒ 10.5712 ≠ 35

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : - and ×

Given equation : 8 × 4 - 7 + 8 ÷ 2 = 35

After interchanging symbols in the given equation is : 

⇒ 8 - 4 × 7 + 8 ÷ 2 = 35

⇒ 8 - 4 × 7 + 4 = 35

⇒ 8 - 28 + 4 = 35

⇒ 12 - 28 = 35

⇒ - 16 ≠ 35

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : + and -

Given equation : 8 × 4 - 7 + 8 ÷ 2 = 35

After interchanging symbols in the given equation is : 

⇒ 8 × 4 + 7 - 8 ÷ 2 = 35

⇒ 8 × 4 + 7 - 4 = 35

⇒ 32 + 7 - 4 = 35

⇒ 39 - 4 = 35

**⇒ 35 = 35**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : × and ÷

Given equation : 8 × 4 - 7 + 8 ÷ 2 = 35

After interchanging symbols in the given equation is : 

⇒ 8 ÷ 4 - 7 + 8 × 2 = 35

⇒ 2 - 7 + 8 × 2 = 35

⇒ 2 - 7 + 16 = 35

⇒ 18 - 7 = 35

⇒ 11 ≠ 35

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"+ and -".**

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by four conclusions. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some women can cook well.

2. All women who can cook well are dancers.

3. Some dancers are players.

**Conclusions:**

I. No dancer can cook well.

II. No dancer is a woman.

III. Some players are women.

IV. No player is a woman.

options.text: Either conclusion III or IV follows.
Both conclusions II and IV follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for given statements is as follows :-

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0126f204b3bcae711997930cb155787ccb294ae4bbc13a41af9663f65caa2444.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d700ce9fe5a8314815c067a7bf5812661a13a557a048352b0af71864b87cfb9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No dancer can cook well → False (As All women who can cook well are dancers so, No dancer can cook well is false)

II. No dancer is a woman → False (As Some women can cook well and All women who can cook well are dancers so, No dancer is a woman is false)

III. Some players are women → True (As Some dancers are players and All women who can cook well are dancers so, Some players are women possibility is true as shown below)

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d08beeb7b2f5da9e862128aef713cbae24a5136005bfea85f945d016d5f57405.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/750f36b1eaa95a7d8401d732f965a6f315da03309cafc7b1a28af41209d091d3.png] 

IV. No player is a woman → True (No player is a woman possibility is true as shown below)

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fdda79f14888fd0add4702378c7fdc71c8dca171e4cb27cd398d11601360983.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/139faa0d9306eb06de3476b6c26215fff71e7767789882d4ea2dc94fe4815b14.png] 

Conclusion III and IV form a complimentary pair.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Either conclusion III or IV follows".**

J_ _G_KP_ _ _PGJ
questions.solution:
Given :- J_ _G_KP_ _ _PGJ

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) GJPKJK → J **G J **G ** P** K P **K J K** P G J

2) KJPGKJ → J **K J **G **P** K P **G K J **P G J

**3) KPJGJK → **J **K P **G **J **K P **G J K **P G J

4) PJKGJK → J **P J **G **K **K P **G J K **P G J

**Option (3) gives a pattern of** J K P G / J K P G / J K P G / J

Or, 

**Option (3) gives a pattern of **JKP - GJK - PGJ - KPG - J
